seo-skills-seo-audit-skill-root.description: Run the SEOmator CLI on a site and score it against 398 rules across 20 categories (SEO, technical, content, security, JS rendering, AI readiness), with reports an LLM can act on. It can also diff two audits to show what a deploy changed. Reach for it to find out why a site underperforms in search, to review a site's health, or to check a release before and after.
seo-skills-seo-audit-skill-root.author: seomator
